summary: Electrovaya filed a Form 6-K furnishing a business update press release dated October 14, 2026. The company guided unaudited FY2026 revenue to a record within prior guidance of approximately $71 million, with audited U.S. GAAP results due early December 2026. It reported completed Factory Acceptance Testing for Jamestown module equipment, progressing cell equipment testing, and launch of the ElvaPulse 1500 stationary storage line at 7 MW per block. Kris Kuzniewski was appointed VP, Data Center Sales. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed; watch execution on Jamestown ramp and ElvaPulse commercialization.
